_comment: <scene-id> authoritative prop list (WP-NN / Tn). Single source: scripts/gen-<scene-id>-gltf.mjs 讀本檔生成 public/assets/scenes/<scene-id>/<scene-id>.gltf,src/scene/scenes/<scene-id>.ts 映射為 SceneConfig.propBounds。座標為 canonical unit (u),displayScale: 1。純裝飾幾何不放這裡——放進 gen script 的 visuals 陣列,才不會參與淨空判定。
